brief:
Settlers have killed 63 Palestinians in the West Bank and occupied Jerusalem since the outbreak of conflict in October 2023, according to data released by the Palestine Information Center, Shehab Wire reported. The figures document fatalities from settler attacks across occupied Palestinian territories over the nearly year-long period.

The Palestine Information Center, a Palestinian research and documentation organization, compiled the casualty data tracking the human toll of settler violence. The deaths represent a significant portion of Palestinian casualties during the conflict, reflecting the ongoing tensions and clashes between settlers and Palestinian residents in areas of the West Bank and East Jerusalem under Israeli military control.
